concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-009 (Sim‑to‑Real Adapter or Fine‑tuning Protocol) has no corresponding task; no task describes implementing or evaluating a fine‑tuning protocol using real‑world videos.

Functional Requirement FR-013 (precision and recall evaluation of the embedding‑to‑SymbolicState mapping) is not covered by any task; no task mentions creating a ground‑truth dataset or reporting precision/recall metrics.

Functional Requirement FR-016 (evaluate the Neural Policy using the deterministic Oracle) lacks a dedicated task; the analysis module (T013) does not explicitly state performing a Neural+Oracle comparison.
The Dependency Map references a non‑existent requirement FR‑018 (baseline GPU metrics); the spec defines FR‑017 for baseline GPU metrics, making FR‑018 a stale tag.
